verdict.rationale: Cekura documents its own API-key creation endpoint, and notes that API-key-authenticated callers can only create project-level keys. That implies credentials can be scoped to a single project rather than the whole account. This is some least-privilege scoping, but there is no evidence of per-permission or read/write scopes, expiry, or agent-specific credential issuance. missing for 10: fine-grained permission/role scopes on keys, read-only or action-limited keys, key expiry/rotation/revocation docs, agent-specific credential guidance, independent corroboration
